modules.name: DriftLog
modules.description: Dual random CV generator with slope shaping, per-channel loop buffers, lock and logic outputs. Software port of the Teia Synthesizers DriftLog Eurorack module.

modules.name: vcATeam
modules.description: Dual velocity VCA. Each channel is a main VCA with offset, attenuverted CV and a linear/exponential response switch, feeding a linear velocity VCA whose input is normalled to 5 V. Both channels are summed to a mix output. Software port of the Teia Synthesizers vcATeam Eurorack module.
